Approved evidence

Digital Divide Data

org.digital_divide_data

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. DDD offers ML data operations, LLM/computer-vision training data, human preference optimization and sensor/physical-AI annotation. Its task scope includes perception, tracking, point clouds, robot manipulation and safety labels. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
